units.text: Chapter 5. PROCUREMENT CONTROL
units.label: Chapter 5. PROCUREMENT CONTROL

units.text: Article 99. Procurement control
units.label: Art. 99

units.text: 1. In accordance with this Federal Law and other regulatory legal acts and legal acts defining the functions and powers of State and municipal bodies, procurement oversight shall be exercised, within their powers, by the following oversight bodies:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 99

units.text: 1) the federal executive authority authorised to exercise procurement oversight, the oversight body for the State defence order, executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and local self-government bodies of municipal districts, municipal okrugs and urban okrugs authorised to exercise procurement oversight;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 99

units.text: 2) the federal executive authority exercising law-enforcement functions for treasury servicing of the execution of budgets of the Russian Federation budget system; the federal executive authority designated by the Government of the Russian Federation under Article 4(6) of this Federal Law; financial bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and municipalities; and management bodies of State extrabudgetary funds;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 99

units.text: 3) internal State or municipal financial oversight bodies designated under the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 99

units.text: 1.1. The oversight bodies specified in paragraph 1 of this Article may not be assigned powers under Article 26 of this Federal Law, except those exercising such powers under paragraphs 2 and 5 of that Article and local self-government bodies of a municipal district, municipal okrug or urban okrug authorised to exercise procurement oversight.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 99

units.text: 1.2. If the oversight bodies specified in paragraph 1 of this Article are assigned powers under Article 26(2) and (5) of this Federal Law, or a local self-government body of a municipal district, municipal okrug or urban okrug authorised to exercise procurement oversight is assigned powers under Article 26 of this Federal Law, the same official of that body may not be assigned both duties for procurement planning, supplier (contractor, service provider) selection, conclusion and performance of State and municipal contracts, including acceptance of goods, work (its results) and services and ensuring payment, and duties for oversight of those procurements.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 99

units.text: 2. Oversight bodies specified in paragraph 1(1) of this Article shall oversee contracting authorities, contract services, contract managers, procurement commissions and their members, authorised bodies and institutions, specialised organisations, operators of electronic platforms and specialised electronic platforms, banks, State Corporation VEB.RF and regional guarantee organisations, when those banks, the corporation and guarantee organisations carry out actions under this Federal Law (hereinafter oversight subjects), in the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation. That procedure shall provide, in particular, for:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 99

units.text: 1) the organisation, subject matter, form, time limits and frequency of inspections and the procedure for documenting their results. In organising and conducting inspections, account shall be taken of the oversight subject's risk category, based on the assessed probability of non-compliance with the relevant requirements of Russian Federation legislation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 99

units.text: 2) criteria for assigning an oversight subject to a particular risk category;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 99

units.text: 3) the procedure and time limits for issuing and complying with procurement oversight bodies' mandatory orders;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 99

units.text: 4) the list of officials authorised to conduct inspections and their rights, duties and liability;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 99

units.text: 5) the procedure for actions by procurement oversight bodies and their officials when oversight subjects fail to comply with mandatory orders, or when information is received that oversight subjects have committed acts or omissions showing signs of an administrative offence or criminal offence;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 99

units.text: 6) the procedure for use of, and document circulation in, the unified information system when exercising oversight.
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 99

units.text: 3. Procurement oversight, other than oversight under paragraphs 5, 8 and 10 of this Article, and subject to paragraph 4 of this Article, shall be exercised by:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 99

units.text: 1) the federal executive authority authorised to exercise procurement oversight, by conducting:
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 99

units.text: а) scheduled inspections of oversight subjects, other than banks, State Corporation VEB.RF and regional guarantee organisations, in procurement for federal needs, and of operators of electronic platforms and specialised electronic platforms;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 3 Art. 99

units.text: б) unscheduled inspections of oversight subjects;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 3 Art. 99

units.text: 2) the executive authority of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation authorised to exercise procurement oversight, by conducting:
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 99

units.text: а) scheduled inspections of oversight subjects, other than banks, State Corporation VEB.RF and regional guarantee organisations, in procurement for the constituent entity's needs;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 3 Art. 99

units.text: б) unscheduled inspections of oversight subjects in procurement for the needs of the constituent entity and of municipalities within its territory;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 3 Art. 99

units.text: 3) the local self-government body of a municipal district, municipal okrug or urban okrug authorised to exercise procurement oversight, by conducting scheduled inspections (other than scheduled inspections of banks, State Corporation VEB.RF and regional guarantee organisations) and unscheduled inspections of oversight subjects in procurement for municipal needs.
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 99

units.text: 3.1. Under agreements between constituent entities of the Russian Federation and municipalities within their territories, the constituent entities' executive authorities authorised to exercise procurement oversight may exercise the powers of local self-government bodies of municipal districts, municipal okrugs and urban okrugs authorised to exercise procurement oversight.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 99

units.text: 4. Oversight of operators of electronic platforms and specialised electronic platforms shall be exercised by the federal executive authority authorised to exercise procurement oversight and the oversight body for the State defence order.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 99

units.text: 5. The federal executive authority exercising law-enforcement functions for treasury servicing of execution of budgets of the Russian Federation budget system, financial bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and municipalities, and management bodies of State extrabudgetary funds shall oversee:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 99

units.text: 1) that funding included in procurement schedules does not exceed the funding for procurement approved and communicated to the contracting authority;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 99

units.text: 2) the consistency of procurement identification code information and non-exceedance of procurement funding amounts contained in information and documents provided for in this Federal Law that, under this Federal Law, are not to be prepared and posted in the unified procurement information system.
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 99

units.text: 5.1. The federal executive authority designated by the Government of the Russian Federation under Article 4(6) of this Federal Law shall use the unified procurement information system to check the consistency of procurement identification code information and non-exceedance of procurement funding amounts contained in:
units.label: Part 5.1 Art. 99

units.text: 1) procurement notices against information in procurement schedules;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5.1 Art. 99

units.text: 2) supplier (contractor, service provider) selection records against information in procurement notices;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5.1 Art. 99

units.text: 3) terms of draft contracts sent under this Federal Law through the unified information system to procurement participants with whom contracts are to be concluded, against information in supplier (contractor, service provider) selection records.
units.label: Point 3 Part 5.1 Art. 99

units.text: 6. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish the procedure for oversight under paragraphs 5 and 5.1 of this Article, including action by oversight bodies when inconsistencies in the information checked are identified. In that procedure, the Government may specify other information and documents to be checked in addition to the information in paragraphs 5 and 5.1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 99

units.text: 7. The oversight powers under paragraph 5 of this Article of financial bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and municipalities and management bodies of State extrabudgetary funds shall be exercised by the federal executive authority responsible for treasury servicing of budget execution if, under Article 220.2 of the Budget Code of the Russian Federation, that federal authority exercises certain functions of those bodies. The corresponding paragraph 5 powers of other such financial and fund management bodies may be transferred to that federal authority under agreements with the highest executive State authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, local administrations or management bodies of State extrabudgetary funds.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 99

units.text: 8. Internal State or municipal financial oversight bodies shall exercise oversight, except oversight under paragraph 10 of this Article, over:
units.label: Part 8 Art. 99

units.text: 1) Repealed from 1 October 2019. — Federal Law of 01.05.2019 No. 71-FZ;
units.label: Point 1 Part 8 Art. 99

units.text: 2) compliance with procurement standard-setting rules established under Article 19 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 8 Art. 99

units.text: 3) determination and justification of the initial (maximum) contract price, the price of a contract with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), the initial unit price of goods, work or services, and the initial total of unit prices of goods, work or services;
units.label: Point 3 Part 8 Art. 99

units.text: 4) Repealed from 1 January 2020. — Federal Law of 27.12.2019 No. 449-FZ;
units.label: Point 4 Part 8 Art. 99

units.text: 5) compliance with this Federal Law's requirements for contract performance and amendment, and compliance with contract terms, including conformity of goods delivered, work performed (its results) or services rendered with those terms;
units.label: Point 5 Part 8 Art. 99

units.text: 6) Repealed from 1 January 2020. — Federal Law of 27.12.2019 No. 449-FZ;
units.label: Point 6 Part 8 Art. 99

units.text: 7) whether use of the goods delivered, work performed (its results) or services rendered corresponds to the procurement objectives.
units.label: Point 7 Part 8 Art. 99

units.text: 9. Procurement oversight under paragraph 8 of this Article shall be exercised in the procedure provided for by Russian Federation budget legislation and other regulatory legal acts governing budget relations, to establish the legality of preparation and execution of budgets of the Russian Federation budget system as regards procurement expenditure and the reliability of its accounting and reporting, in accordance with this Federal Law, the Budget Code of the Russian Federation and regulatory legal acts adopted under them, by:
units.label: Part 9 Art. 99

units.text: 1) the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision in the financial and budget sphere, over procurement for federal needs and procurement for constituent-entity or municipal needs financed partly or wholly by subsidies, subventions or other earmarked interbudgetary transfers from the federal budget;
units.label: Point 1 Part 9 Art. 99

units.text: 2) the State financial oversight body that is an executive authority or official of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, over procurement for that constituent entity's needs and procurement for municipal needs financed partly or wholly by subsidies, subventions or other earmarked interbudgetary transfers from the constituent entity's budget;
units.label: Point 2 Part 9 Art. 99

units.text: 3) the municipal financial oversight body that is a body or officials of the local administration, over procurement for municipal needs.
units.label: Point 3 Part 9 Art. 99

units.text: 10. The oversight body for the State defence order shall exercise procurement oversight, other than oversight under paragraphs 5 and 5.1 of this Article, through scheduled and unscheduled inspections of the oversight subjects specified in paragraph 2 of this Article in procurement under the State defence order and procurement of goods, work and services for federal needs outside that order where the information constitutes a State secret. In that sphere, it shall exercise oversight under this Federal Law over:
units.label: Part 10 Art. 99

units.text: 1) compliance with requirements for procurement justification and its soundness;
units.label: Point 1 Part 10 Art. 99

units.text: 2) procurement standard-setting under Article 19 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 10 Art. 99

units.text: 3) determination and justification of the initial (maximum) contract price, the price of a contract with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), the initial unit price of goods, work or services, and the initial total of unit prices of goods, work or services;
units.label: Point 3 Part 10 Art. 99

units.text: 4) the contracting authority's application of liability measures and other action when the supplier (contractor, service provider) breaches contract terms;
units.label: Point 4 Part 10 Art. 99

units.text: 5) conformity of the goods delivered, work performed (its results) or services rendered;
units.label: Point 5 Part 10 Art. 99

units.text: 6) the timeliness, completeness and accuracy of accounting records for goods delivered, work performed (its results) or services rendered;
units.label: Point 6 Part 10 Art. 99

units.text: 7) whether use of the goods delivered, work performed (its results) or services rendered corresponds to the procurement objectives.
units.label: Point 7 Part 10 Art. 99

units.text: 11 - 11.1. Repealed from 1 January 2020. — Federal Law of 27.12.2019 No. 449-FZ.
units.label: Point 7 Part 10 Art. 99 · “11 - 11.1. Repealed from 1 January 2020. — Federal Law of…”

units.text: 11.2. The federal executive authority exercising control and supervision in the financial and budget sphere shall inspect how State or municipal financial oversight bodies that are executive authorities or officials of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, or bodies or officials of local administrations, oversee compliance with this Federal Law, in the procedure established by the federal executive authority responsible for State policy and regulatory legal regulation in budget, taxation, insurance, currency and banking activities.
units.label: Part 11.2 Art. 99

units.text: 12. Scheduled and unscheduled inspections shall not review the results of evaluation of procurement applications under the criteria in Article 32(1), points 3 and 4, of this Federal Law. Procurement participants may challenge those results in court.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 99

units.text: 13. The procurement oversight body shall conduct scheduled inspections of each contracting authority, its contract service, contract manager, standing procurement commission and its members, authorised body or institution, and operator of an electronic platform or specialised electronic platform no more than once every six months.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 99

units.text: 14. The procurement oversight body shall conduct scheduled inspections of each specialised organisation and procurement commission other than the commission specified in paragraph 13 of this Article no more than once during each supplier (contractor, service provider) selection procedure.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 99

units.text: 15. The procurement oversight body shall conduct an unscheduled inspection on the following grounds:
units.label: Part 15 Art. 99

units.text: 1) receipt of a procurement participant's complaint against acts or omissions of oversight subjects. The complaint shall be considered under Chapter 6 of this Federal Law, except for challenges under paragraph 15.1 of this Article. If an unscheduled inspection is based on a participant's complaint, a single decision shall be adopted on the results of the inspection and consideration of the complaint;
units.label: Point 1 Part 15 Art. 99

units.text: 2) receipt of information indicating violations of Russian Federation legislation or other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system, including:
units.label: Point 2 Part 15 Art. 99

units.text: а) applications or communications from an individual, legal entity, public association or association of legal entities exercising public oversight, indicating signs of such violations;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 15 Art. 99

units.text: б) discovery by the procurement oversight body of signs of violations of Russian Federation legislation or other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 15 Art. 99
